description: Generate pre-signed S3 URLs for uploading or downloading files. Use BEFORE run_script when an operation requires a local file. Use for direct S3 uploads/downloads. Max upload 5 GB; larger files use multipart. For uploads: generates PUT URL. For downloads: generates GET URL. No special headers needed unless s3_params provided—then corresponding HTTP headers MUST be included or request fails with SignatureDoesNotMatch.

expires_in.description: URL expiration in seconds (1–900). Above 900 → S3 rejects with 403.

region.description: Override region. Falls back to session region.

s3_params.description: Extra S3 parameters to sign (e.g. ContentType). Corresponding headers MUST be included.

name: aws-mcp__aws___get_presigned_url
